dimensions.issue_validity: Legitimate, well-investigated bug. The Kiro sous-chef template misinterprets parent-child dependency metadata as real blockers, producing false BLOCKED verdicts.
dimensions.actionability: Highly actionable. Fix scoped to Kiro sous-chef template: distinguish parent-child (structural) from blocks (execution-order) deps, and align verdict definitions with Claude Code/OpenCode versions.
dimensions.project_relevance: Directly relevant to core autonomous loop functionality. Affects serve phase, signal detection, and circuit breaker.
dimensions.priority_signal: High priority. Makes the entire autonomous loop non-functional for the Kiro CLI backend.
dimensions.proposed_direction: Update Kiro sous-chef template Check Dependencies step to distinguish dependency types. Align Kiro verdict definitions with other backends.

rationale: Well-diagnosed, high-impact bug that makes the Kiro autonomous loop unusable. Fix is scoped to template content — no Python changes needed. The sous-chef needs guidance on distinguishing structural parent-child deps from real execution blockers.
